IT is hereby decided under the Secretary Decision Number 01 dated 15.01.2025 that the roads and lanes or paths included by Local Councils in Sabaragamuwa Province published by the Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province in the Gazette Extra Ordinary No. 2316/20 dated 24th January, 2023 to be read with Section 24(1) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987 Sabaragamuwa from the series "Orders on the preparation of road plans and publication of notices showing the list of names". In accordance with the work assigned to the Local Councils of the Province in the following Schedule should be declared as roads and lanes or paths owned by the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha and any road and lane or path included in the said Schedule among the roads and lanes mentioned in the Schedule published in the Gazette 2420/75 dated 25.01.2025 which have not been ﬁ led before the date speciﬁ ed in the said announcement and a case was ﬁ led in a proper court before the date on which the announcement was speciﬁ ed said announcement.

It is further announced that a name list of every road and lane or path included in the Schedule hereby and every road and lane or path included it shall be deemed to be a road or lane owned by Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha in accordance with Sub-section 5 of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act.
